images.caption: PolyMesh pipeline: STEP/B-rep CAD through feature analysis and a gradient-limited sizing field into the hybrid meshers, unified FE+VEM assembly, solve, ZZ error estimate and the hp-adapt decision that feeds back into the sizing field.

Feature-graded vs PolyMesh's own frozen uniform tet10 baseline on the D6 L-domain: 6,384 -> 1,248 DOF and 2.762 s -> 0.227 s at the same energy deficit band. Internal self-comparison, not a comparison against any external solver.

Method-of-manufactured-solutions energy-norm convergence: frozen P1 elements at 0.997/0.997/2.000/2.000 against theory 1/1/2/2, and the hierarchical p-basis at 1.02/1.99/2.98/3.98 against theory 1/2/3/4.
Tier-1 analytical verification: every case inside tolerance, measured on structured parametric verification meshes rather than product Cartesian grid-fill meshes.

Close-up on the hole (identical camera in both panels, 40 mm window): uniform (--no-feature, h = 5.1 mm) vs feature-graded (h = 5.6 mm) sizing on the same part and mesher, h tuned to a matched element budget: 18,912 vs 18,944 cells (0.2% apart), 12,426 vs 13,719 DOF.
Tile of compare_grading.png: feature-graded sizing field, 4,573 nodes / 18,944 cells.
Tile of compare_grading.png: uniform sizing field  (--no-feature), 4,142 nodes / 18,912 cells.

Mesh-only renders of the same plate at h = 6 mm under three meshers — tet: 1,884 nodes / 6,840 cells · graded: 4,629 nodes / 18,887 cells · hybrid: 11,960 nodes / 9,104 cells. All are Cartesian grid-fill topologies, not Delaunay.
Tile of compare_meshers.png: graded mesher, 4,629 nodes / 18,887 cells.
Tile of compare_meshers.png: hybrid mesher, 11,960 nodes / 9,104 cells.
Tile of compare_meshers.png: tet mesher, 1,884 nodes / 6,840 cells.

Cantilever beam: von Mises stress on the graded mesh (h = 30 mm, 3,327 nodes / 13,008 elements, 9,981 DOF); root face (x < 1e-3 m) fixed, tip face loaded; displacement warped ×200; colour range 0 – 6.46e+06 Pa (clipped at the 99th percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 4.09e+13 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.

Cylinder: von Mises stress on the graded mesh (h = 12 mm, 3,719 nodes / 17,186 elements, 11,157 DOF); base z < 0.015 m fixed, cap z > 0.195 m loaded; displacement warped ×2000; colour range 0 – 1.75e+06 Pa (clipped at the 99th percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 2.3e+06 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.

Cone and ball: von Mises stress on the graded mesh (h = 10 mm, 5,459 nodes / 25,533 elements, 16,377 DOF); base z < 0.02 m fixed, ball z > 0.10 m loaded; displacement warped ×1000; colour range 0 – 2.27e+06 Pa (clipped at the 95th percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 3.12e+07 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.

Plate with hole: von Mises stress on the graded mesh (h = 6 mm, 4,629 nodes / 18,887 elements, 13,887 DOF); min-x face fixed, traction on max-x face (CLI default BC set); displacement warped ×200; colour range 0 – 1.26e+07 Pa (clipped at the 99.5th percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 3.62e+13 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.

Sphere: von Mises stress on the graded mesh (h = 8 mm, 4,771 nodes / 23,381 elements, 14,313 DOF); cap z < -0.04 m fixed, cap z > 0.04 m loaded; displacement warped ×2000; colour range 0 – 1.3e+06 Pa (clipped at the 92nd percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 3.6e+07 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.

Flagship render: von Mises stress across the plate with hole on the feature-graded mesh, shot from a low oblique angle (h = 6 mm, 4,629 nodes / 18,887 elements, 13,887 DOF); min-x face fixed, traction on max-x face (CLI default BC set); displacement warped ×200; colour range 0 – 1.26e+07 Pa (clipped at the 99.5th percentile of the visible surface); peak nodal value 3.62e+13 Pa at the clamped-face stress singularity.
